text:
anya: Morning — FRA edge cluster B had a thermal event during intake, 5 H100s flagged with surface burn marks. Depot holding them pending RMA or local swap.

carl: Oof. Serial numbers? photos? how bad?

mei: Photos uploaded to ticket TKT-4981. Serials: H100-A091, H100-A092, H100-A093, H100-A094, H100-A095. Depot estimates 72h triage unless we request expedite.

vendor-john: We can offer two flows: 1) Depot-level swap (refurb in EU pool) ~24-72h depending on stock; 2) Factory RMA air express ~next-day but 500/unit uplift + customs clearance.

anya: What's lead time on refurb stock at the FRA depot?

vendor-john: Current refurb stock at FRA: 2 H100 immediate, 3 pending refurb return by EOD+1. So if we do staggered swaps: 2 immediately, rest by day+2.

procure: Cost delta please (include customs preclear).

vendor-john: Refurb swap: 00/unit handling. Factory express: 500/unit (air) incl. preclear. Road expedited ~00/unit but 18-36h.

amelia: Any chance for uplift credit? We had a contractual 30% credit for expedited RMAs in Q1.

vendor-john: Contract terms: 30% credit applies if failure is manufacturer defect and claim accepted. Thermal/surface damage may need adjunct evidence. If we bundle >6 returns this quarter, we can escalate to finance for better uplift.

carl: These photos show pad melt and possibly overheating from rack airflow issues. Ops will review. Should we prioritize gen-serve routes?

ops-bot: incident logged INC-2028-112 (FRA cluster B thermal intake). Auto-page oncall.

mei: Operational ask: vendor wants single manifest CSV with serial, photo link, and failure code. They prefer HS 8471.80.00 and value declaration set to 
000/unit for customs.

anya: Draft manifest I used last time:

```
AWB: <TBD>
Model: NVIDIA H100
Ser# , Status , PhotoURL , FailureNotes
H100-A091, candidate-RMA, https://tickets/redwood/4981/1.jpg, thermal-pad-delam
H100-A092, candidate-RMA, https://tickets/redwood/4981/2.jpg, scorch-bottom
H100-A093, candidate-RMA, https://tickets/redwood/4981/3.jpg, scorch-top
H100-A094, candidate-RMA, https://tickets/redwood/4981/4.jpg, discoloration
H100-A095, candidate-RMA, https://tickets/redwood/4981/5.jpg, heat-stain
Preferred: refurb-swap 2 units now, factory express for 3 if credit approved
```

vendor-john: Good manifest. I'll prebook AWB provisional for one express unit to test flow. Need sender name + depot drop cutoff 09:30 CET. Also need invoice copy for customs value.

procure: We have invoice template. Who signs for exchange on site?

amelia: @carl or @anya can sign. I'll coordinate purchase order if we take express.

carl: Onsite ops available 08:00 CET tomorrow for handoff. Customs broker: our EU-broker XpressTrade is on file.

anya: Two negotiation items: 1) ask vendor for 40% uplift credit on express for 2 units if claim accepted; 2) request depot refurb swap with overnight courier for 2 units at no charge to avoid immediate capacity loss.

vendor-john: I'll push both asks. Finance says 40% on two units might be doable if we accept refurb swap for the other three and mark root-cause as manufacturing (subject to review). Need short RCA bullet points from ops.

mei: I'll draft 3 bullets: 1) rack exhaust failure -> localized hotspot; 2) thermal pad delamination visible; 3) immediate mitigation: redistribute load and raise inlet temp alarm.

procure: Also confirm whether replacements should be 'refurb exchange' (no invoice) or 'advance replacement' (invoiced then refunded). Which is cheaper on paperwork?

vendor-john: Refurb exchange simpler: handling fee only. Advance replacement has invoice and warranty reclaim — slower finance but better stock guarantee.

anya: Given latency-sensitive routes impacted (gen-serve-high, realtime-ams), do advance replace for one critical unit and refurb swap the rest.

carl: Agreed. Advance replace for H100-A091 first. Stagger others.

vendor-john: Noted. I'll provisional AWB 980-FR-A091 booked (provisional) 1:45 CET. Will confirm final AWB and uplift-credit answer by 17:00 CET.

ops-bot: AWB provisional created 980-FR-A091. Ticket TKT-4981 updated.

mei: Thanks. Please keep manifest attachment and final credit terms in this thread.

vendor-john: Will do. If finance approves 40% on 2 units, please commit to manifest and drop by 09:15 tomorrow.

anya: Copy. I'll post the 3-bullet RCA in the ticket and update here. :ok_hand:
